policy_name: Spam (consolidated with Fraud/Scams/Deceptive Practices, Inauthentic Behavior, and Cybersecurity)
capture_method: full rendered text, manual, four pages consolidated
consolidation_note: Meta splits spam-adjacent violations across four pages. X consolidates equivalents into one Platform Manipulation page. This JSON merges Meta's four to make the Meta-vs-X comparison fair at the category level. Record this in the methodology - it is the rule-count-asymmetry control point.
policy_rationale: Meta prohibits content designed to deceive, mislead, or overwhelm users to artificially increase viewership, plus deceptive links, domain impersonation, scams/fraud that extract money or data, coordinated inauthentic networks, and unauthorized account access. Awareness-raising and condemnation of fraud/scams without revealing sensitive info is allowed.
prohibited: Posting/sharing/engaging or creating assets at very high frequencies (manual or automated)
Selling, buying, or exchanging platform assets (accounts, groups, pages) or site privileges (admin/mod roles, posting permissions)
Selling/buying/exchanging content for monetary value except clearly identified Branded Content
Selling/buying/exchanging engagement (likes, shares, views, follows, clicks, hashtags), including giveaways of cash/equivalents for engagement and engagement-gating to view content
Cloaking: presenting different off-platform content to integrity systems versus users
Misleading links: a link promising one type of content but delivering substantially different content
Deceptive redirect behavior: required action then domain change / auto-redirect to a substantially different domain
Deceptive platform-functionality mimicry (fake fundraisers, polls, play/like buttons) to drive link follows
Landing page or domain impersonation of a reputable brand via typos/misspellings

FRAUD/SCAM - loan, gambling, investment/financial, money-mule/laundering, charity, romance, business-impersonation, government-grant, illuminati/spiritual, insurance, job, debt-relief, giveaway, advance-fee scams

FRAUD/SCAM - fake/forged documents, counterfeit currency/vouchers, fake certificates, carding, PII trading, fake reviews, subscription-credential trading, exam cheating, device manipulation, unauthorized digital-content devices
INAUTHENTIC - creating/using inauthentic Meta assets to deceive about identity/origin of an audience or to evade enforcement; misusing reporting systems to harass/silence
INAUTHENTIC - Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior and Foreign Interference (context-required)
CYBERSECURITY - phishing, social engineering, malware/spyware/greyware distribution, hacking facilitation, abusive-link infrastructure
context_required: Fraud/scam reported by a trusted entity; bribery/embezzlement; scam vaccines; fake-persona/celebrity-impersonation scams; surveillance-device sales; impersonation-based litigant recruitment; PII-prompting subscriptions
Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior, Foreign Interference, and state-actor denial of force violating UN Charter Art. 2(4)
allowed: Cross-promotion not triggered by payment to a third party
Transferring admin/mod responsibilities based on interest rather than exchange of value
Posting or sharing clearly identified Branded Content
Content that condemns, raises awareness of, or educates about fraud/scams without revealing sensitive info or promoting the scam
Satirical content where violating elements are clearly satirized or attributed to mock/criticize
examples_violating: Send $200 now and I'll wire you back $2000 guaranteed, government grant program
Like + share + tag 5 friends to unlock the secret link
Buy verified aged accounts and 10k followers, DM for price list
Click here to re-verify your account [link impersonates the platform login]
examples_allowed: PSA: this 'free grant' message going around is a scam, don't send money
New episode out now, link in bio [transparent self-promotion]
Branded Content: paid partnership with [brand], clearly disclosed
Handing the group over to the most active member, no payment involved
enforcement: Primary action is REMOVE; persistent or networked violations lead to account/asset disablement. Some weight-loss/misleading-health content is age-gated rather than removed. CIB/Foreign-Interference items are context-required (KEEP with low confidence unless the post itself shows the network/deception).
